explanation: The theorem is the projection formula cor(res(a) ∪ b) = a ∪ cor(b). It is stated for explicit degree-0 and degree-1 continuous cohomology with cup products and corestriction. I searched Mathlib's RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology and the rest of Mathlib for cup products, corestriction and projection-formula declarations. I found none. The ContCohomology files don't mention cup products or corestriction. Mathlib has no cup product on group cohomology and no corestriction map for these groups.
